description: This file contains utility functions for testing, version control, and GitHub API interactions within a PyTorch project, including functions for handling test names, PR numbers, merge bases, changed files, commit info, and test ratings.

methods.name: python_test_file_to_test_name
methods.description: Converts a set of test file paths to test names by removing prefix and suffix.

methods.name: get_pr_number
methods.description: Retrieves the pull request number from environment variables or GitHub refs.

methods.name: get_merge_base
methods.description: Determines the merge base commit for the current branch, considering PRs and default branch.

methods.name: query_changed_files
methods.description: Returns a list of files changed since the merge base commit.

methods.name: get_git_commit_info
methods.description: Gets commit information since the last commit on the default branch.

methods.name: get_issue_or_pr_body
methods.description: Fetches the body content of a specified GitHub issue or PR.

methods.name: normalize_ratings
methods.description: Normalizes test ratings to a specified max and min value.

methods.name: get_ratings_for_tests
methods.description: Loads test ratings from a JSON file and aggregates scores for changed files.

methods.name: get_correlated_tests
methods.description: Returns tests sorted by their ratings, prioritizing higher-rated tests.
